summary: The original mismatch was the omitted do_wear.c:Boots_off() and off_msg() calls at the end of hack.c:dosinkfall(). The JS port now invokes Ring_off()/Boots_off() and off_msg() in C order; the selected sink fall case matches all 37 screens/cursors and 2,586 RNG calls.

source.branch: spoteffects runs on an IS_SINK square while levitation is active; when levitation comes only from worn boots and the hero is not innately levitating, blocked, or flying, dosinkfall takes the fall branch, then removes worn levitation items and reports each removal.
callers: hack.c:spoteffects() calls dosinkfall() for IS_SINK && Levitation.
do_wear.c:Boots_on() calls spoteffects(FALSE) after float_up() when levitation boots newly activate.

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/do_wear.c:186-259: Boots_on() activates levitation boots, calls float_up(), then spoteffects(FALSE) when Levitation is true.
nethack-c/upstream/src/hack.c:3320-3354: spoteffects() calls dosinkfall() when the current terrain is a sink and Levitation is active.

nethack-c/upstream/src/hack.c:836-922: dosinkfall() crashes when levitation is only extrinsic from boots, restores the saved levitation fields after damage, then removes levitating rings and boots and calls off_msg(obj) in source order.
nethack-c/upstream/src/do_wear.c:67-72,262-323: off_msg() prints the removal message and Boots_off() clears the footwear slot and recalculates levitation in source order.

Before the fix, .cache/A2-v39-sink-diff-fresh.log showed identical RNG values (2586/2586) but the first screen/cursor mismatch at boundary 33, segment 1, zero-based step 32, input space: C reported the boots removal message after the death refusal; JS skipped it.
After the fix, .cache/A2-v39-sink-after.log reports exact parity: 2586/2586 RNG calls, 37/37 screens, 37/37 cursors, and no animation frames.
js/hack.js:2062-2134 now calls the existing Ring_off(), Boots_off(), and off_msg() implementations in C source order; js/do_wear.js exports its existing off_msg() helper for the hack.c caller.

challenges/cases/v39/v39-sink-levitation-boots-pickup.recipe.session.json reaches this path by wishing a sink and levitation boots, picking up the boots, and wearing them on the sink; the admitted recording supplies the complete matching replay.
